texts.facts: The Applicant has approached this Court seeking quashment of First Information Report No. 0349.2020 registered with Hingoli Rural Police Station, Hingoli, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, Sections 26(2)(iv), 26(2)(i), 27(2)(E), 27(2)(A), 27(3)(D), 2(3)(E), 30(2)(a) and 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and consequential proceedings bearing Rcc No. 506/2023 pending on the file of 3 rd Judicial Magistrate First Class, Hingoli.
texts.arguments: 2 . Learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that the implication of the Applicant is on the basis of the statement of the co-accused, which is impermissible in law. Except the bare assertions at the instance of the co-accused, there is no incriminating material on record collected during the course of investigation. As such, learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that continuation the proceeding would lead to abuse of process of law and prays for exercise of inherent powers so as to meet the ends of justice. 3. Per contra, learned APP opposed the application submitting that the Applicant is involved in an offence under Indian Penal Code and the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

As such, learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that continuation the proceeding would lead to abuse of process of law and prays for exercise of inherent powers so as to meet the ends of justice. 3. Per contra, learned APP opposed the application submitting that the Applicant is involved in an offence under Indian Penal Code and the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
